discipline: every implemented handler tests the condition stated in harvesting-rules.json; unimplemented rules fail closed to Z and can never return T

handlers.tests: observed tree (git rev-parse <head>^{tree}) == expected_tree bound from the frozen corpus index; unresolvable head -> Z
every changed path vs base startswith an authorized prefix AND the diff is non-empty
sorted changed-path set == sorted expected set
blob length == bytes AND sha256 == expected AND (sha512 == expected when bound); missing blob -> F
no duplicate declarations; every declared member resolves and reproduces bytes+sha256(+sha512); no unmanifested files beyond the self-excluded manifest
parsed field value == expected (absent field compares as sentinel and fails); missing artifact -> Z
array non-empty AND every element's field is literally true
blob length == n (or <= n_max when bound so); missing -> F
content equals the bound literal / alt literal / other blob / parsed-JSON value; missing -> F
path not present in the item tree
parsed JSON list == exact bound argv list
sorted failing-ID set == sorted expected set
declared but not bound by any current gate; handler not present -> would fail closed to Z
zip member length == bytes AND sha256 == expected; missing member -> F
same checks as manifest_accounting over zip members
unit sets equal; changed units within allowed set; changed count == expected; hunk count == expected; named unit byte-identical
UNIMPLEMENTED - always fails closed to Z with reason recorded; never returns T
